newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Air plans to raise its capital by $250 million, aviation sources say.
- Oman Al Ahli Muscat Bank says it will open a representative office in Dubai.
- Yemen expects its oil income to reach $950 million in 1997.
- Saudi Eastern province chamber of commerce offers investment opportunities worth 1.8 billiom riyals.
- Saudi Hadeed Company's sales in 1996 were worth 2.5 million tonnes.
